branch.biome: coastal forest (forest/dense_forest/jungle/taiga that is also coastal, any elevation)
branch.model: a deep Mediterranean ancestor of the Latinate/Hellenic and Punic families

_note: Elvish demihuman culture, the sea-and-coastal-forest branch of the Vaneth (family_elvish.json). Smooth, lilting Mediterranean speech (vowel-rich -os/-a/-eth, sibilants s/sh, a light Punic pharyngeal touch); the SMOOTH branch-law on the Proto-Elvish roots. An ancient thalassocratic realm of elder-houses, golden-age now mostly fallen to island- and headland-fastnesses. Predominantly Neutral (the worldly, trade-minded coast): weights {Lawful 0.20, Neutral 0.60, Chaotic 0.20}, though a realm can seed or drift to either pole. Seeds only where forest meets the sea: coastal forest/dense_forest/jungle/taiga, any elevation (setting-lore 5.2 #50). As the deep Mediterranean ancestor, its deity- and concept-roots prefigure the human Latinate/Hellenic/Punic forms (Aiternaros -> Aeternus/Aiternos/Atharon; Tularos -> Tulrios/Tulrish). DEITY names take the Thalvaneth SACRED GENDERED ending -aros (masc) / -aressa (fem) - the divine class, distinct from mortal -os/-ios/-a and the common-noun -os; never real Greek/Roman/Punic gods. Common-word lexicon and rank register may use the real Mediterranean register (nesos, oinos, porphyros, kedros) per catalog 5.3.

phonology.palette: Thalvaneth: smooth and lilting (Mediterranean sea-elf); vowel-rich endings -os/-a/-e/-eth; sibilants s/sh; a light guttural/pharyngeal touch (the Punic descendant); flowing open syllables; the SMOOTH branch-law on the Proto-Elvish roots.
phonology.phonotactics: CV/CVC, vowel-rich and open; sibilants and liquids frequent; no glottalization.

morphology.patronymic_form: the elven house (genos/oikos) by an elder-line; -ios (son of) / -a (daughter of); a use-name given freely, a true-name kept private.
morphology.compounding_rule: [quality|root](stem) + feature/realm: Kelar-siros (silver-river), Thalo-nesos (sea-isle); -anos for the realm, -anar for the seat.

title_ladder.government: feudal (an ancient thalassocratic realm of elder-houses, now mostly island- and headland-fastnesses; the Tharos over the elven lords, the lore-singers and the marine-archers)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Smooth Mediterranean Thalvaneth reflexes of the Proto-Elvish title ladder, ascending - the same seven ACKS tiers as the Aelvaneth, with -os endings. A golden-age thalassocracy, now fallen to island/headland-fastness enclaves. (These title-roots are the elder ancestors of the human Latinate/Hellenic/Punic lord/king terms.)

people_name_convention.order: a use-name (given freely) + the house (genos/oikos); a true-name kept private; -ios/-a; lilting two-element names.
people_name_convention.dual_register: the elder-houses carry an ancient house-name; a use-name is given freely, a true-name guarded.
people_name_convention.theophoric: mortal theophorics weave the power's ROOT (never the divine -aros/-aressa ending) + soft elements: -dios (devotee), Galar-/Kelar- (light/silver): e.g. Tular-dios (devotee of Tularos), Galar-rialt.

religion._note: Deity-names are the Thalvaneth (smooth Mediterranean) reflexes of the Proto-Elvish theonym roots (family_elvish.json) - the eldest forms of the Agrippan canon, never real Greek/Roman/Punic gods; they carry the sacred GENDERED ending -aros (masc) / -aressa (fem) - the divine class, distinct from mortal -os/-ios/-a and common-noun -os. The Thalvaneth are predominantly Neutral (weights L20/N60/C20); the worship/demonize set follows the realm's CURRENT alignment (see worship_by_alignment), but the cultural default is the worldly Neutral coast - the genos-ancestors, the sea-spirits and the sea-mother foremost. The alseos (sea-grove shrine) above the harbor is the altar.
religion.the_one: Aiternaros (< Proto-Elvish Atyarnaaron < Aeternus; sacred-masculine ending -aros; the distant Star-Father; among the predominantly Neutral Thalvaneth honored from afar but rarely central; revered when Lawful, named the Sky-Tyrant when Chaotic)

Realta.gloss: the mother, mercy, patroness of safe voyage; Neutral-honored, fem.

Tulrius.gloss: the sun and just light; Lawful power, masc.

Numeno.gloss: sky-wisdom and navigation; Lawful power, masc.

Maraxus.gloss: the storm-war, the corsair's ruin; Chaotic power, masc.

worship_by_alignment.Neutral: the worldly majority are ambivalent toward both poles; they foreground the genos-ancestors (the edhros), the sea-spirits and the sea-mother Numyaressa, and the local lore-saints, honoring the One only distantly
worship_by_alignment.Lawful: the high-court reveres the One (Aiternaros) and the Lawful powers (Tularos, Orlandaros, Gaianaros, Numenaros), demonize the Chaotic powers
worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: the corsair-houses venerate the Chaotic powers (Maraksaros the storm-war, Wakidaros the void, the drowning-powers), demonize the Lawful powers and the One

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the demonized set (by current alignment): when Lawful - Maraxus -> Maraksaros the Ruin; when Chaotic - Aeternus -> Aiternaros the Sky-Tyrant, Tulrius -> Tularos the Cruel-Sun.
religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Alseos (sea-grove shrine) of [power]: 'the Alseos of Rialtaressa', above the harbor.
religion.saints_pattern: the elder-navigators and lore-singers of the houses (the edhros), honored at the shore-shrine and the white headland.

holy_symbol_motifs.Rialtaressa: a moon-star above a calm sea
holy_symbol_motifs.Tularos: a rayed sun over a silver wave
holy_symbol_motifs.Numyaressa: a pearl cradled in a cresting wave

banks_patterns.ships: sea-galleys and coast-craft, dolphin-prowed: 'the Silver Wave', 'Star-of-the-Deep', 'the Swan of Thalos'
banks_patterns.military_units: the marine-archers and house-galleys: 'the Sea Wardens', 'the Pearl-Archers of [house]'
banks_patterns.taverns: the harbor-hall (elves keep halls, not taverns): 'the Hall of the Silver Wave', 'the Wine of Stars'
banks_patterns.dungeons_ruins: drowned elven sea-halls and sunken headland-fastnesses: 'the sunken Hall of [house]', 'the Drowned Alseos of [name]'
